Subject: Clarification regarding RFQ for Corrugated Boxes - FY2026-27

Dear Deccan Corrugators Team,

Thank you for your proposal regarding our annual rate contract for corrugated boxes. To proceed with our evaluation, please provide clarification on the following points:

1. Regarding Line 25, are you offering the 3-ply (200/150/200 GSM) as an alternative to our specified 5-ply (180/120/150/120/180 GSM), and if so, can you provide supporting test data or a revised quote matching our original specification?
2. Regarding Line 16, are the 150 GSM offerings for layer 1 and layer 5 intended as alternatives to our specified 180 GSM, and if so, can you provide supporting test data or a revised quote matching our original specification?
3. For the volume discount mentioned on Line 19, does this apply to the quantity per order or the total quantity per year?

We look forward to your prompt response.

Regards,

Category Buyer, Sahyadri Consumer Products Ltd, Chakan MIDC, Pune
